purpose: Teach: 乗り込む/やって来る/得よ/上質/ニュースレター/上乗せ/不可避/初旬

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、現場に、絶対、急行、乗り込む形で、まいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police will absolutely rush to the scene with full commitment. Thank you sincerely.
lines.style: Measured and official. Steady opening, clear cadence on key commitments. Warm undertone beneath the formality—this is a genuine pledge, not rote procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様、本気で、絶対、当社に、絶対、やって来る時、絶対、ご案内、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When the police arrive at our location, we will absolutely ensure thorough guidance. Thank you sincerely.
lines.style: Respectful and engaged. Slightly formal register—matching the officer's tone. Steady pace, light emphasis on 'thorough.' The warmth of someone who means what they're saying.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証言を、本気で、絶対、得ようと、絶対、市民、絶対、ご協力、感謝、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're committed to gathering witness testimony and appreciate the public's cooperation entirely.
lines.style: Professional but not distant. Slight lift on 'witness'—these are real people being heard. Measured pace. The tone of someone conducting serious work with care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、上質な、絶対、商品、絶対、警察様にも、絶対、ご評価、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company's high-quality products have earned the police department's own recognition. We're grateful for that.
lines.style: Earnest and proud without boasting. Gentle emphasis on 'recognition.' The satisfaction of knowing the work speaks for itself. Calm, respectful pacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、ニュースレター、絶対、市民、絶対、発行しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police actively distribute community safety newsletters to the public. We're thankful for that effort.
lines.style: Clear and informative. Slight emphasis on 'actively distribute'—this is something worth noting. Professional tone, steady rhythm. Recognition without ceremony.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格に、本気で、絶対、防犯費用、絶対、上乗せ、絶対、お客様にも、絶対、ご理解、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our customers understand and accept that security measures are reflected in our pricing. We appreciate their understanding.
lines.style: Practical and straightforward. No apology, no over-explanation. Light emphasis on 'understand'—customers get it. Calm, matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 犯罪、本気で、絶対、撲滅、絶対、不可避、絶対、警察、絶対、頑張ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Crime prevention is essential, and the police are committed to doing everything possible. We're grateful for that dedication.
lines.style: Steady and resolute. Slight weight on 'committed'—this is a promise being made. Even pace, warm undertone. The voice of someone aligned with the mission.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。月の初旬、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、巡回、絶対、強化、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the increased police patrols throughout the month. It makes a real difference.
lines.style: Warm and genuine. Light satisfaction in the voice—this is relief and appreciation combined. Slightly softer on the close, trailing off with warmth rather than formality.
